title: OrderErrorEvent
description: Event describing an error for one or more order items.

order_reference_id.description: A unique, case-sensitive ID of the order in Canva's system. This must be the same value as the `orderReferenceId` path parameter.

items.description: A list of updates to items in the order.

request_type.description: The type of request. Must be `error_event`.

items.description: Describes the errors on the items.

ErrorDetails.description: The error details of the item. Errors details should be cleared from an item after it has been resolved.

description.description: A human readable message that describes the cause of the error.

ItemErrorEvent.description: The updates to be made to an item in the order.

item_reference_id.description: A unique, case-sensitive ID for an order item that the print partner can use when communicating with Canva.

error_details.description: The error details of the item.
